title: Planned change: a vendor credit from a return links to it; bills as before
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with Reports page access and Vendor Order Management View.
  • Vendor Y has an unused vendor credit from a vendor return at your location, an unused vendor credit not from a return, and an unpaid bill at your location.
custom_steps:
1. Open the Reports menu.
  2. Click "A/P Aging Detail" in the left list.
  3. Open every bucket.
  4. Click the No. of the vendor credit from the return.
  5. Press the browser Back button.
  6. Point at the No. of the other vendor credit.
  7. Click the bill's No.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 4:

  • PRD v12, S7-R9, quoted: “On A/P Detail and A/P Unpaid Invoices, a vendor credit's number links to the vendor return it came from, under the same rules and permissions as a bill (S7-R6). A vendor credit that did not come from a vendor return shows as plain text.”
  • Step 4 (our restatement, not the PRD's words): The vendor return opens (production showed vendor credits as plain text).
  • Step 6 (our restatement, not the PRD's words): The credit not from a return is plain text.
  • Step 7 (unchanged from before the release): The bill opens its delivery page.
  • Related existing case: S7-07 C715420 (https://shopview.testrail.io/index.php?/cases/view/715420); S7-08 C715421 (https://shopview.testrail.io/index.php?/cases/view/715421). This case checks the same planned change from the before-the-release side.

Why this matters: The new link must not disturb the bill links users rely on.

SOURCE: A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter PRD (Confluence 947650561) v12, 12 Nov 2026, S7-R9. V1 behaviour before the change: ShopView/shopview at fc08f23 (production v26.45.3), app/src/components/ts/reporting/accounts-payable/ApAgingDetailReport.vue:305-313; app/src/components/ts/reporting/accounts-payable/ApAgingDetailReport.vue:499-508.

This is the expected behaviour as per the A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter PRD (Confluence 947650561) v12, 12 Nov 2026, S7-R9, for epic SV-11315; the V1 behaviour it changes is recorded in AR-AP-V1-BASELINE.md (INV-138). Last checked against build v26.45.4-b8c04e2 (staging) on 11/12/2026.

AUTOMATION: READY
